QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary] The Administrator's Balloons
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has some entertaining news for you. Wonder what it is?
QuestInfo.1: According to Cassandra, #b#p9010000##k is using #r#o9010011#s#k to celebrate the 9th anniversary. She has planned it so they many of them will appear all over Maple World.\nAnd on these #o9010011#s will be gift boxes, courtesy of the Maple Administrator. They say that a special letter comes with the gift box as well.
QuestInfo.2: According to Cassandra, #b#p9010000##k is using #r#o9010011#s#k to celebrate the 9th anniversary. She says they are appearing all over Maple World. And along with a gift from the Administrator, there's a letter from the developers!

0.0: The Maple Admin's usually a snooze fest, but even she's getting into the spirit of the 9th anniversary! She's pasted her face on #e#b#o9010011#s#k#n and scattered them around Maple World. She's trying out a new way of distributing #e#r9th Anniversary Gift Boxes#k#n!
0.1: There are two types of balloons. #r#e#o9010011#s#k#n are out in the fields and #r#e#o9010012#s#k#n show up in towns. The town balloons are so big, you'll need a group to pop them! \r\nHow about popping some balloons and getting yourself some of those gift boxes?

yes.0: The Maple Admin also attached developer notes on the balloons. They should make for a fun read!

no.0: Are you really going to let those gifts float by?

1.0: Oooh, I wish I had time to pop balloons! Did you get to read a developer's note, too? Lucky!

yes.0: And here's my gift! I'll call it... #r#eCassandra's 9th Anniversary Present#k#n! Yup, I'm a prodigy at naming things!

mob.0: There are two types of balloons. #r#e#o9010011#s#k#n are out in the fields and #r#e#o9010012#s#k#n show up in town. The Maple Admin also attached developer notes on the balloons, so start poppin'!
